description: This file contains the implementation of a request handler for listing tags in the Conduit application, using MediatR for CQRS pattern, Entity Framework Core for database interaction, and related data structures.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: A record that implements IRequest for requesting a TagsEnvelope

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the Query request to list tags from the database

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves tags from the database, ordered by TagId, and returns them wrapped in a TagsEnvelope
